zones.label: Section 101
zones.description: Section 101 puts you close to the stage from the left side, with strong performer detail and an angled view across the production.

zones.label: Section 102
zones.description: Section 102 is the closest centered Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot. You get a direct view of the illusions while keeping the large-scale lighting and video lined up in front of you.

zones.label: Section 103
zones.description: Section 103 puts you close to the stage from the right side, with strong performer detail and an angled view across the production.

zones.label: Section 201
zones.description: Section 201 is part of the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot. It gives you a strong middle-distance view from the left while keeping the full production easy to take in.

zones.label: Section 202
zones.description: Section 202 is the centered middle-house Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot. It is far enough back to read the pyro, screens and full-stage effects together without giving up a direct sightline.

zones.label: Section 203
zones.description: Section 203 is part of the Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot. It gives you a strong middle-distance view from the right while keeping the full production easy to take in.

zones.label: Section 301
zones.description: Section 301 gives you the widest elevated angle from the left side and a clear read on the full scale of the production.

zones.label: Section 302
zones.description: Section 302 is an elevated Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot with a broad view of the stage while staying close to center.

zones.label: Section 303
zones.description: Section 303 is the centered upper-level Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot. You get the cleanest straight-on elevated view of the full production.

zones.label: Section 304
zones.description: Section 304 is an elevated Vegas Sidekick Sweet Spot with a broad view of the stage while staying close to center.

zones.label: Section 305
zones.description: Section 305 gives you the widest elevated angle from the right side and a clear read on the full scale of the production.
